said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

On National Coming Out Day, we celebrate LGBTQI+ Americans living openly and authentically, and stand with everyone still deciding when, how, or whether to share that part of themselves.

Two more suburban police officers face charges for allegedly misusing Flock license plate cameras to conduct unauthorized searches.
This is exactly why I introduced the bipartisan NO FLOCK Act. Surveillance technology cannot become a license to track Americans without accountability.
https://t.co/zp0BzXVn8K

Captain Smit Machchhar risked his life to save 172 passengers and his fellow crew members when his co-pilot attempted to hijack Flydubai Flight 1073.
I'm honoring his extraordinary courage in the Congressional Record. His heroism deserves our nation's recognition. https://t.co/wJORSl3Nec

Chicago lost a Bears legend today. Mike Ditka helped bring our city championships as both a player and a coach, including the unforgettable 1985 Super Bowl season. His legacy will live on for generations of Bears fans. My condolences to his family and loved ones. https://t.co/2bIpsaiTay

I wrote in CyberScoop about a growing threat Washington is overlooking: quantum computers could break the encryption protecting our financial records, military communications, and national security secrets.
Foreign adversaries can steal that data today and decrypt it later. Congress must act now. https://t.co/bWfLGqeDST

At a time of the largest measles outbreak in 35 years, the Trump Administration is rejecting settled science, underreporting measles deaths, and delaying vaccine access for children. I joined my colleagues in demanding answers from the CDC. Our kids deserve better. https://t.co/VIIMAzOBYg

I’m calling for an immediate classified briefing on the major outages affecting airlines, banks, and technology companies.
Americans deserve answers. Is our critical infrastructure secure? What vulnerabilities need to be addressed? And what are we doing to prevent even more serious disruptions?

If Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick refused to enforce our export control laws and allowed sensitive American technology to reach China, he needs to go.
No one should be above accountability when our national security is at stake. https://t.co/yDpziygabI

Trump's immigration crackdown is tearing families apart and leaving workers afraid to go to their jobs. It's also hurting the businesses that depend on them, driving up prices, and damaging our economy.
These cruel policies are hurting all of us. https://t.co/yoAkl10uCY

Secretary Duffy wants billions more for FAA upgrades, but according to official figures, only $1 billion of the $12 billion already provided has been spent. Where's the accountability? Congress must bring it. https://t.co/908YbAMNAN

We cannot leave the enforcement of critical semiconductor export controls to the discretion of the White House. Congress must pass stronger laws through this year's defense authorization to keep advanced American technology out of China's military. https://t.co/Wzwn50kzmk

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
